records.author: admin_302
records.title: Why Higalaay means more than a festival calendar
records.excerpt: For Kagay-anons, Higalaay is a public expression of friendship, gratitude, creativity, and city pride that stretches across neighborhoods, stages, streets, and shared memories.
records.body:
Higalaay is where thanksgiving traditions, cultural showcases, local performance, food gatherings, sports events, and civic celebrations meet in one citywide season.

For residents, it is a return to shared identity. For visitors, it is one of the clearest ways to experience how Cagayan de Oro welcomes people in.

records.title: Opening Salvo and City Welcome
records.excerpt: The Opening Salvo gathers visitors, city groups, performers, and organizers into one welcoming start.
records.body:
The Opening Salvo gathers visitors, city groups, performers, and organizers into one welcoming start. It sets the tone for the festival with music, color, route announcements, and a clear sense of where the celebration is headed.

Arrive early for easier movement around the grounds and to catch the pre-program atmosphere before the main welcome begins.

records.title: River Day Tours
records.excerpt: River Day Tours connect the city celebration to one of Cagayan de Oro's most recognizable adventure experiences.
records.body:
River Day Tours connect the city celebration to one of Cagayan de Oro's most recognizable adventure experiences. Visitors can plan guided outdoor routes with clearer pickup points, safety reminders, and a gentler bridge between city events and nature-based tourism.

Book early, verify weather conditions, and follow tour operator guidance for clothing and belongings.
